      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie</link>
      <description><p>Paul Mackenzie convicted over deaths of children and one adult after followers were ordered to starve themselves and their families</p><p>The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult disasters in recent history.</p><p>The sentence, comprising 100 years for murder by starvation and 100 years by direct homicide, came two weeks after the court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/19/kenya-starvation-cult-leader-guilty-murder-190-children">found the cult leader guilty</a> of the crimes.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections</link>
      <description><p>Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result</p><p>The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.</p><p>Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994. High unemployment, crime, corruption and poor local service delivery have all contributed to <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/anc-south-africa-local-elections-water-outages-power-cuts">voters turning away from the party</a>.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Party expected to get less than a third of the vote amid frustration over water outages and power cuts</p><p>The African National Congress is on course for a bruising result in South Africa’s local elections on Wednesday as voters go to the polls amid deep discontent over water outages, power cuts and crumbling infrastructure.</p><p>The former liberation movement, which Nelson Mandela led to power in 1994 at the end of apartheid as South Africa’s first black president, is still likely to be the largest party.       <description><p>President has opposing views on many issues, and once called Leo’s predecessor the ‘representative of the Evil One’</p><p>Trees are being planted in the garden.       <description><p>What are the relationships and dominant interests in play, as the summit kicks off after a bitter row over its hosting?</p><p>Hosting Cop was a <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/audio/2021/oct/25/australia-v-the-climate-part-1-kyoto">key pledge from Australia’s prime minister, Anthony Albanese in 2021</a>, while in opposition, before his successful election campaign. The final compromise put Australia in charge of the negotiations which will take place in the Turkish city of Antalya. The bitter taste left by the row lingers and Australia has seemed to some a rather half-hearted host.       <description><p>Event regarded as Oscars of fashion industry replaces John Galliano retrospective with homage to the ‘extra ordinary’</p><p>A few months after the planned John Galliano Met Gala retrospective was cancelled amid a backlash focused on the designer’s past, a more commonplace theme has been announced: “<a href="https://www.metmuseum.org/exhibitions/extraordinary-fashion-and-the-poetics-of-the-everyday">extraORDINARY</a>: fashion and the poetics of the everyday.” It has left some commentators speculating that celebrities might replace the <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/fashion/2017/oct/18/guo-pei-chinese-designer-who-made-rihanna-omelette-dress">couture “omelette dresses”</a> and four-part red-carpet performances with jeans and a nice top.</p><p>While the dress code for the next Met Gala, which will be held on 3 May 2027, is yet to be announced, it traditionally derives from the exhibition theme.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/fashion/2026/nov/08/met-gala-2027-theme-poetics-everyday">Continue reading...</a></description>
